item.description:
0.8.2

Four ways a text transfer could damage something, closed.

  • It wrote over the target before checking the bytes. It now decodes beside the file and only renames on a checksum match — a bad transfer leaves what was already there untouched.
  • A name starting with - broke every command, because quoting does not stop rm or mv reading it as an option.
  • Receiving replaced a same-named file on the Mac non-atomically.
  • Nothing checked the device had opened the file before sending thousands of lines that its shell would then read as commands.
